_demo: fiktiv / synthetic demo data. Kammfux is an invented product; its names, domain and colours below are invented too. palette and pairs are the new product Taktilo (also invented), checked by contrast.py.
_about: Read by sweep.py (brand mode) and checked before launch. avoid: the original's names, company names and product names. domains: its domains. colors: its brand colours as hex. near: Delta E below which a colour counts as 'the same colour at a glance' (warning). allow: files where the name is there on purpose (licence attribution, a reviewed comparison page). palette and pairs: the new product's colours and the combinations the design uses, read by contrast.py (sweep.py ignores them).
